summary: ServiceCode represents a system entity for categorizing and managing codes related to services within the HSPnet framework.
purpose: To manage service-related codes, including their categorization and localization support.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Identifier for the category to which the code belongs.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short name representation of the code.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order in which the code should appear when sorted.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Additional notes related to the code.

fields.name: NameAlt
fields.description: Alternative name for the code used in localized settings.

fields.name: NotesAlt
fields.description: Alternative notes for the code used in localized settings.

business_rules.name: Localization
business_rules.description: Use alt-language fields if the session is running in alternate language mode.
